transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’ve just been feeling a little watched at work. I drive routes, and lately it seems like dispatch and compliance are tracking my route changes through the computer system more than usual. And there are these little comments on the radio that feel… pointed, like they’re about me.

I know people say it’s just normal oversight, and maybe I’m not explaining it right, but I can tell certain drivers are reporting on me. I didn’t want to make it sound dramatic—I just thought I should come in and talk to someone, if that makes sense.
Can you tell me more about the feeling that people are watching you or reporting on you? Do you believe they are acting with a specific purpose or intention toward you?

I mean… I don’t want to make it sound like I think everyone is out to get me or anything. It’s just, with dispatch and compliance, it feels like they’re watching my route changes through the computer system more closely than they need to.

And then on the radio, there’ll be these little comments that seem like they’re about what I’m doing, even if they don’t say my name. Certain drivers too… I can tell some of them are reporting back on me. I guess I’m not totally sure what the purpose is, but it feels intentional, not just regular supervision. Does that make sense?
When you hear these comments on the radio or interactions from dispatch, do you feel that they are specifically directed at you, even if others don’t seem to notice the same thing?

Yeah… I guess it does feel like that. I know that might sound like I’m reading into things, and I don’t want to seem difficult, but when dispatch says certain things or there are those radio comments, it feels like they’re meant for me, even if they don’t say my name.

Like with the route changes, I can tell they’re tracking them through the system, and then certain drivers seem like they’re reporting back. Other people might not notice it, but to me it feels pretty specific. Does that make sense?
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are being put into your mind by someone else, taken out of your mind, or broadcasted so others can hear them?

Um… no, I don’t think so. Not like my thoughts are being put in or taken out. And I don’t think people can hear what I’m thinking.

I mean, I do worry about what people at work are noticing, but that’s more about things happening on the radio or the computer system, not my thoughts. Is that… is that the kind of thing you mean?
Outside of work, do you ever feel like people are watching you, talking about you, or acting against you in any way?

Outside of work… not really, or at least not in the same way. I don’t want to make it sound like I think strangers everywhere are watching me.

It’s mostly tied to work — dispatch and compliance tracking my route changes through the computer system, the radio comments, and certain drivers seeming like they’re reporting back on me. That’s where it feels like something is going on. Outside of that, I guess I’m more on edge sometimes, but I haven’t noticed the same kind of thing. Does that answer it okay?
Have you ever had thoughts that something strange or unusual was happening that others didn’t seem to notice, even outside of work?

Um… outside of work, I don’t really have a big example like that. I mean, this whole thing is mostly why I’m here — the dispatch and compliance stuff, the route changes showing in the system, and then little comments on the radio that seem connected to it.

People say it’s just normal oversight, and maybe I’m… maybe I’m taking it too personally, I don’t know. But it does feel like certain drivers are reporting on me, even if nobody else seems to notice it the same way. Outside of that, I can’t think of anything as clear. Is that okay?
Have you ever had any beliefs or ideas about things happening that other people around you don’t seem to believe are true?

Yeah… I guess that’s probably the work thing I’ve been trying to explain.

I don’t want to sound like I’m accusing everybody or making it bigger than it is, but I’m here because it really does seem like dispatch and compliance are tracking my route changes through the computer system. And then there are these little comments over the radio that feel connected to what I just did, or where I went.

Other people say it’s just normal oversight, and I know that could be true, but… I can tell certain drivers are reporting back on me. At least that’s how it feels. I’m not trying to be difficult — that’s just the part that doesn’t seem to line up with how everyone else explains it.
Do you believe that what you’re experiencing at work is definitely true, even if others have told you it might just be normal oversight or that you might be misinterpreting things?

I mean… I don’t want to say “definitely” like I’m trying to argue with everyone. I know people have told me it could just be normal oversight.

But it really does feel true to me. That’s why I’m here. The route changes show up in the system, and then dispatch or compliance seems to know, and sometimes there are these little radio comments that line up too much with what I just did. And certain drivers… I can tell they’re reporting back on me.

I’m not trying to make it sound dramatic. I just don’t know how else to explain it. Does that make sense?
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, especially around the same time these work-related concerns started?

A little, yeah… I don’t know if I’d call it hopeless exactly. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is.

But I haven’t really felt like doing the things I normally do. Like choir — I used to like singing, and I just… don’t feel like going. And I haven’t wanted to have the softball team over either, which I usually would.

Most days after my shift I kind of just sit at the kitchen table with my planner open, like I’m going to get organized, but then I can’t make myself start dinner or return calls or do anything. I feel bad saying that because it sounds lazy, but it’s not really that. I just get stuck. Is that the kind of thing you mean?

Have you experienced periods where you felt persistently sad, lost interest in most activities, had trouble sleeping or slept too much, felt guilty or worthless, or had difficulty concentrating, nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yeah… I think so, at least with the interest and concentration part. I don’t want to overstate it, because I’m still getting to work and everything.

But I don’t really feel like singing with choir lately, or having the softball team over like I normally would. And most days after my shift I sit at the kitchen table with my planner open, like I’m going to get things together, but then I just… can’t seem to start dinner, or return calls, or really do anything else.

I don’t know if that counts as nearly every day, but it feels like it’s been happening a lot. Is that what you mean?

Have you ever experienced any strange or unusual ideas that others don’t seem to share, or have you ever felt like things were happening that you just couldn’t explain, even when people close to you didn’t see it the same way?

Yeah… I mean, I guess that’s kind of why I’m here.

I don’t want to say it in a way that sounds unreasonable, but at work it feels like dispatch and compliance are tracking my route changes through the computer system. And then sometimes there’ll be these little comments on the radio that seem to line up with what I just did, like they know.

Other people have said it might just be normal oversight or that I’m reading into it, and I’m trying to hear that. But certain drivers… I can tell they’re reporting back on me. I know that probably sounds strange when I say it out loud, but that’s what it feels like. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Have you ever felt that things people say or do in public—like things on TV, in conversations, or even strangers’ actions—are directed at you or have a special meaning just for you?

Maybe not TV so much… or I haven’t really noticed that. But at work, yes, it can feel like things people say are meant for me.

Like the little comments on the radio after I change a route — they’ll say something that lines up too closely, and it feels like dispatch or compliance are tracking it through the system. I know people tell me it’s just normal oversight, and I’m trying not to make too much of it, but… certain drivers, it really feels like they’re reporting back on me.

I’m not trying to sound paranoid. It just feels directed at me sometimes. Does that answer what you mean?

Have you ever felt that things happening around you—like things people say, actions they take, or events in your environment—are specifically connected to you or controlled in a way that others don’t seem to notice?

Yes… I mean, I don’t want to make it sound bigger than it is, but that is sort of what I’ve been trying to explain.

At work, when I change a route, it feels like dispatch or compliance already know through the computer system, and then there’ll be a comment on the radio that seems too specific to be random. People tell me it’s probably just normal oversight, and I do try to keep that in mind, but certain drivers… it really seems like they’re reporting on me.

I know that may sound odd. I’m not trying to be difficult or anything. It just feels connected to me in a way other people don’t seem to notice.
Outside of work, have you ever felt that things people say, actions they take, or events happening around you are specifically connected to you in a way others don’t seem to notice?

Outside of work… not really, or at least not in the same way. I don’t want to exaggerate it.

It’s mostly tied to my job — dispatch, compliance, the computer system showing my route changes, and then those little radio comments that feel like they’re aimed at me. And certain drivers… I know people say they’re probably not reporting on me, that it’s just normal oversight, but it really feels like they are.

So outside of work, I guess I haven’t noticed it much. It’s mainly there. Does that make sense?

Even though others have told you that what you're experiencing at work might just be normal oversight, do you still feel certain that certain drivers are reporting on you and that dispatch and compliance are specifically tracking your route changes with intent?

I mean… yes, I do still feel that way. I’m trying to be fair about it, because I know people have said it could just be normal oversight, and I don’t want to sound like I’m accusing everyone.

But when I change a route and then there are these little comments on the radio that line up with it, it feels too specific. It feels like dispatch and compliance are seeing it through the system, and certain drivers are reporting back on me.

I know how that sounds, and I’m not trying to make trouble. But yes… I can tell there’s intent behind it, at least with some of them.

Do you feel that your concerns about being watched and reported on at work are definitely true, even though others have told you they are not, and do these concerns happen in the absence of feeling unusually low or depressed?

Yes… I think so. I mean, I know people keep telling me it’s probably just normal oversight, and I do try to hear that. I don’t want to seem like I’m being unreasonable.

But I’m here because it really does feel definite to me — like dispatch and compliance are tracking my route changes through the computer system, and then the little comments on the radio kind of confirm it. And certain drivers… I can tell they’re reporting on me.

And no, it’s not because I’m feeling especially low or depressed. That’s not really what’s driving it. It’s more that these things keep lining up at work, and I can’t just ignore that. Does that answer it okay?
